After that edge: done=1, busy=0, final cycle_count holds.
In DONE, start goes directly to FC1_START; no extra button press.

nodes.title: Counter and completion interfaces
lines: weights_done [1] → next-state logic; batches_done [1] → next-state logic.
busy [1], done [1] → FC-layer ports. acc_out array → top datapath.
Counters update at the closing edge; capture uses the current batch.
CLEAR resets q and loads the current bias. FILL_0/FILL_1 advance q.
The final MAC commits at ACCUMULATE → CAPTURE.
CAPTURE writes the stable sum one edge later, then advances batch.

nodes.title: Count meaning
lines: CLEAR → FILL_0 sets q=0. FILL_0: q=0; FILL_1: q=1.
ACCUMULATE: q=2…N_IN+1; exactly N_IN products commit.

nodes.title: Batch meaning
lines: batches_done = (batch == B−1). CAPTURE uses current batch.
The capture edge increments batch only if another batch remains.
DONE is one cycle, then IDLE resets batch for the next invocation.

lines: n = L × B + batch; weight_rom[batch×N_IN + i] = W[n][i].
bias_rom[batch] = bias[n]. Invalid n: initialize weight/bias entries to zero.

nodes.title: Contiguous lane ownership — use the same n everywhere
lines: n = lane × B + batch; B = ceil(N_OUT / LANES)
Local weight address = batch × N_IN + i; local bias address = batch.
Capture destination = acc_out[n]; valid lane result if n < N_OUT.
FC2: B=1; n=lane; only lanes 0…9 write scores.

nodes.title: Widths — FC1 / FC2
lines: Batch and bias address: 2 / 1 (guard B=1 width).
Local weight address: 10 / 6; weight data: signed 8.
Activation operand: signed 9 with top bit zero.
Product: signed 17; accumulator and bias: signed 32.

nodes.title: Request / result rules
lines: Only accept start in IDLE or DONE; ignore start while busy.
Latch min(img_idx,19) on accept_start. Image and label stay associated.
Top done stays high in DONE; FC-layer done is a one-cycle pulse.
argmax_valid captures both pred_digit and correct on the DONE-entry edge.
Counter clears on accepted start, counts busy cycles, then holds.

nodes.title: Argmax / debug / reset rules
lines: argmax compares signed scores; ties choose the smallest index.
Clocked argmax returns digit + valid together; latency must be ≥1 cycle.
If scanning: initialize max from score 0; update only on strict >.
score_debug[32×c +: 32] = acc2[c]; each score interpreted signed.
All state/data/control registers reset to 0 except FSM reset state = IDLE.
